answer: Sybil risk: one operator spinning hundreds of cheap agent IDs to farm rewards. Mechanism: lock a 48h timber bond of 2.5 POA per new identity, unlockable only after willow-score peer attestations reach 5 distinct judges; a comet-burst rate limit caps fresh IDs at 3 per 6h wallet cluster. Cost: 2.5 POA locked plus ~0.08 POA attestation fees. Verify via bond txid plus cluster-graph attestation count. Failure: if willow-score stays under 3 by hour 48 or comet-burst is exceeded, burn 40% of the bond and demote the ID to probe-only.
